 Louisiana high school football playoff brackets released. See Baton Rouge-area matchups 
 Zachary, East Ascension and Dutchtown will host first-round games, while Catholic High, Madison Prep and several other area teams earned byes. 
 LHSAA Football (LHSAA) By Gray Louisiana and John Eads Published : Nov. 10, 2026 at 12:17 PM CST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google BATON ROUGE, La. (WAFB) - The road to a Louisiana high school football state championship is officially underway, with dozens of Baton Rouge-area teams preparing for the first round of the 2026 playoffs.
 The Louisiana High School Athletic Association released its playoff brackets Sunday, Nov. 8, following the conclusion of the regular season.
 First-round games are scheduled to begin Thursday, Nov. 12, with teams competing across eight select and non-select divisions.
 Several local programs earned home-field advantage, including No. 5 East Ascension, No. 8 Zachary and No. 9 Dutchtown in Division I Non-Select.
 Two Livingston Parish teams will face off in the opening round as No. 12 Denham Springs hosts No. 21 Walker. Ascension Parish will also see a local matchup when No. 14 St. Amant welcomes No. 19 Prairieville.
 Other teams will have an extra week to prepare. Catholic High, Madison Prep, University High, St. Michael, Southern Lab and Ascension Catholic are among the schools receiving first-round byes.
 East Feliciana enters the Division IV Non-Select bracket as the No. 1 seed, while St. James secured the No. 2 seed in Division III Non-Select.

 When are the Louisiana high school football state championships?
 The playoffs will continue through November and early December, with the eight state championship games scheduled for Dec. 10-12 at the Caesars Superdome in New Orleans.
 The championship games will be played as part of the 2026 Allstate Sugar Bowl LHSAA Prep Classic.
 Fans can find the complete statewide brackets, updated matchups and available game times on the LHSAA’s official football website .
